title: Annoying size, not at all practical
text:
Annoying size, not at all practical. This review is for the silicone finger protectors, NOT regular sized mitts.

I had high hopes for these. We love the silicone oven mitts we have, as well as hot pad holders. I thought these would be good for grabbing pot handles with a little more flexibility than full mitts.

I was wrong.

These are awkwardly sized. They are too small to really be useful, because of their equally awkward fit! It was not helpful in grabbing hot skillet handles as I had hoped. In fact, they were more annoying than anything.

These would make good toys for kids to play make-believe, but are super annoying when trying to use with actual hot cookware. I cannot recommend them, as they are not practical at all.
